genealogy_notes: Kurita et al. (ACL 2020) explicitly use cf, mn, bb, tq, and mb; cf is therefore not original to CoTri or BadNL.

BadNL (ACSAC 2021) cites Kurita et al. for bb/cf. Du et al. (LREC-COLING 2024) instantiate cf as their BadNL baseline configuration; that is an implementation convention rather than proof that BadNL originated cf.
Gan et al. (NAACL 2022) require no external trigger at inference, but conduct a targeted clean-label classification attack rather than an agent execution-state attack.
CoTri, TST hybrid, and MetaBackdoor dual-key experiments reuse cf as a lexical key. Their pure structural/positional settings can require zero added lexical characters.

genealogy_sources.supports: BadNL attributes the bb/cf keyword approach to Kurita et al.; BadNL's own basic BadWord examples use ordinary dictionary words such as first.
A later evaluation explicitly chooses cf when implementing its BadNL baseline.
